chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Ben Webster in Europe: dinner talk of gangsters
summary: Webster cared about young musicians but he and McPherson talked only gangsters, Baby Bell and Lucky Luciano.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Yeah. Ben seemed to really care about younger musicians. He was sort of like --
Yeah, like a father, an uncle.
I remember in Europe, he invited me over to dinner, me and Charlie McPherson. All they talked
about was gangsters. They liked gangsters.
He knew a lot of them?
He knew one of the baddest ones in Chicago, Baby Bell.
The one I knew. He was very close to him.
Never heard of him. What sort of -- what did he specialize in?

He was a pimp in a gangster suit. (Unintelligible.) He was a cross between getting the bootleggers in the bootlegger days. Bootleg whisky and even narcotics, and the numbers over to the black people, to the Mafia.
Lucky Luciano was -- that was the first integration of the Mafia, that I know of.
